Prevention: Before planting, remove infected stubbles and weeds from the field.
Plant with wider distance of 25cm x 25cm.
Potassium fertilizer at the tillering stage to strengthen the stem and leaf tissues.
Sulphate on leaf during the tillering stage.
Monitoring: Scouting 3 times per week especially when the weather is cool and close to booting stage.
Observe for oblong to irregular spots, with gray centers and brown margins.
Observe for spots or rotting on the leaf sheath that encloses the young panicles.
Observe for discoloration in the sheath.
Direct Control: Remove infested plants by burning or composting.
Mancozeb; Use 1kg /200/l water/ ha; Non-systemic, contact action
Carbedazim; Use 1kg/ 200/l water/ ha; Non-systemic, contact action
Restrictions: Spray in morning between 6-10 am or in afternoon between 3-6 pm
U (Unlikely to present acute health hazard)
